newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 890,600 MT were three and three-quarters times the week earlier and one-half above the 4-week average.

The primary buyers were Japan (363,500 MT), Egypt (167,900 MT, includes 85,100 new sales, 82,800 destination changes) South Korea (161,400 MT, includes 59,800 new sales, 104,500 destination changes), South Africa (57,600 MT, includes 600 new sales, 57,000 destination changes) and Israel (40,000 MT). Reductions were reported for unknown destinations (112,300 MT).

Exports of 863,500 MT were 19 percent below the prior week and 23 percent under the 4-week average. The primary recipients were South Korea (214,300 MT), Egypt (140,400 MT), Japan (107,700 MT), Taiwan (103,300 MT), and South Africa (57,600 MT).
